🚪 Open Rooms for Players

Players only see "Join" now — you create the room/table/case here, then share the code with them.

🧹 Reset Player Unlock

Undo an approved unlock for one player — e.g. to clean up a fake/test receipt. This removes it from Firebase, so they'll see the paywall again next time the app loads (their old localStorage will get overwritten on resync).

🔑 Force Unlock (No Receipt)

For a player whose receipt genuinely won't upload (bad photo, HEIC, flaky connection). Ask them for their Player ID, pick the tier they paid for, and unlock it directly — no receipt image needed. Use responsibly; this skips verification.

🎮 Log Game Donation (No Receipt)

Same idea, for a per-round game donation that a player couldn't attach a receipt to.

💰 Tier Pricing

Type a new amount and tap Save. Updates apply instantly for every player, on every device.

🎱 Bingo Card Purchase Receipts

Players pick how many cards to buy when they join (or rejoin) a Bingo room, then upload proof of payment here. Approving is what lets them into the room — until then they wait on a pending screen. 📥 Tap to download receipt images (ZIP)

Top Donors reads each player's own running total, which can drift out of sync from the real receipts if one ever gets deleted straight from the database (instead of rejected in-app) — that player keeps a "phantom" balance forever. Tap the button above to rebuild every player's total strictly from today's approved receipts. Safe to run any time; it never touches the receipts themselves.

Updates live as players play, across every device. Export a CSV backup before resetting — it can't be undone. If any receipts have photos attached, a green "Tap to download" button appears below after the CSV — tap it yourself to get the ZIP (phones block auto-downloading a second file).
